Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

doubt verb and noun

also doubts, I doubt whether, no doubt, without doubt, I have no doubt that, there is no doubt that, call into question, without question

classical

Cic. Off. 1.30: quod dubitēs aequum sit an inīquum
Traupman 97, 306

dubitō, dubitāre, dubitāvī, dubitātum

verb, first conjugation

doubt, be unsure

With a question (utrum … an, -ne … an, num), with dē and the ablative, or with a neuter pronoun. “I have no doubt that” is nōn dubitō quīn with the subjunctive (Lewis & Short), or nōn mihi dubium est quīn (Traupman 97, 306); an accusative and infinitive comes in only with Nepos and Livy, and then after a negative (Lewis & Short). On its own, dubitō an, like haud sciō an, leans to yes, “I rather think” (Lewis & Short, s.v. an). With an infinitive, dubitō is “hesitate” (Cic. Sen. 25).

Other words

  • dubitātiō, dubitātiōnis f. — doubt, uncertainty

    noun, third declension · classical · Cic. Phil. 14.10: sine ūllā dubitātiōne

  • dubium, dubiī n. — doubt: sine dubiō, no doubt; in dubium vocāre, call in question

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Sen. Ep. 53.1: erat sine dubiō caelum grave; Cic. de Or. 2.145: quae in dubium vocārentur

    The neuter of dubius, doubtful; haud dubiē, undoubtedly, is the word of Sallust and Livy (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • quōcircā bene praecipiunt quī vetant quicquam agere quod dubitēs aequum sit an inīquum

    so they advise well who forbid us to do anything when we are in doubt whether it is fair or unfairCic. Off. 1.30

  • neque enim dubitārī potest, quīn artis pars magna contineātur imitātiōne

    for there can be no doubt that a great part of any art lies in imitationQuint. 10.2.1

  • Modicae fideī, quārē dubitāstī?

    O you of little faith, why did you doubt?Vulg. Mt. 14.31

  • Nōn mihi dubium est quīn …

    I have no doubt that …Traupman 306

  • in dubium vocāre

    to call into questionTraupman 367

  • sine dubiō

    without questionTraupman 367

See also sure, certainly, unclear, believe.
